end.summary:
- Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
- Om identified a standing line as upright and a sleeping line as lying flat.
- Om initially said a tilted/slanting line was not straight because it looked tilted.
- Later, Om stated that a slanting line is not bent and is therefore straight.
- Teach-back was not passed; 4 of 7 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping and slanting lines with Om, using direction and whether a line bends as the method. Om correctly described standing lines as upright and sleeping lines as lying flat. They first mixed up “tilted” with “not straight,” and later corrected this by explaining that a slanting line can be tilted without bending. At home, ask Om to find one standing, one sleeping, and one slanting straight edge, then check whether each is bent or not.
